trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload. This is the top Android crasher at ~4% of sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Owner: Marcus. Deadline: fixed and verified by Wednesday (August 12th) so QA has time before the August 20th release. Acceptance criteria: crash no longer reproduces on Android 14.

trello.name: Verify Android 14 crash fix on test devices
trello.desc: Once Marcus lands the Android 14 photo upload crash fix, confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run. Owner: Sam. Deadline: before the August 20th release.

trello.name: Build backend sync API for offline notes mode
trello.desc: Build a sync API endpoint where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for this pass; no merge UI. Owner: Elena. Deadline: have the sync API in review before Elena is out on August 17th-18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Implement client-side offline support: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity returns. Write the acceptance criteria into the ticket: user can open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Owner: Marcus. Deadline: this sprint (August 10th-21st).

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Finish migrating CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions: complete the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before turning Jenkins off. Jenkins must stay alive until the parallel week is clean. A proof of concept for the build job already exists. Owner: Sam. Deadline: this sprint (August 10th-21st).

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint to prevent degradation from misbehaving scripts. Limit: 100 requests per minute per user. Beyond the limit, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Also add a metrics counter so we can see who is hitting the limit. Owner: Elena. Deadline: this sprint (August 10th-21st).

trello.name: Update privacy policy consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Update the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Nothing should be pre-checked. This is a launch blocker and must be in the August 20th release. Owner: Marcus. Deadline: August 20th release.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal: have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline. Owner: Sam. Deadline: this sprint (August 10th-21st).
